short: ' p' / ' п' as a one-letter first piece of a split Spanish or Russian word
notes: Card: max 292, density 0.35%, FLAG positional (81% of top peaks at position 0); the non-positional peaks are ' p' x4 and ' п' x2 as the first letter of a split word (p|ide, p|ista, p|one, p|aga, п|анорамный, п|ляже), plus ' –' and ' information' at position 0. Tokenizer: pidió, piso, poca, pata, puso, pinta, pala, pila, pinto = ' p' + rest; para, pero, puede, pudo, parte, padre, pena, poder are whole tokens; пьеса, пляж, пыль, пила, пена, пустой = ' п' + rest, пол, пара, после, потом are whole. Probe: pide 0.910, pista 0.750, pone 0.756, paga 0.745, панорамный 0.562, пляже 0.522; 'propuesta pero quiere que se cobre' 0.232 (peak ' prop'), 'cumple con sus impuestos' 0.029, прекрасный 0.000. Fire items use pidió, piso, poca, pata, puso, pinta, пьеса, пыль mid-sentence; near misses are the same sentences with whole-token p-words (para, parte, mucha, padre, pudo, prefiere, опера, дорога). The positional component is noted, not tested; Russian sentence-initial capitals are one-letter tokens (В, У) in both the fire and the quiet item of each pair, so they cancel.
